source.zh: GEO 官方 suppl 目录列表 + 官方 suppl/filelist.txt（精确字节数）+ HEAD 抽样核实；SRA 关联来自 NCBI SRA runinfo / ENA portal API（按数据集记录中的 BioProject 查询）
source.en: GEO official suppl directory listing + official suppl/filelist.txt (exact bytes) + sampled HEAD checks; SRA linkage from NCBI SRA runinfo / ENA portal API, queried by the BioProject recorded in the series metadata

policy.zh: 文件名与地址只取自官方元数据，绝不由 GSE 编号推测；无法核实的记录不给下载命令。
policy.en: File names and URLs come from official metadata only and are never inferred from a GEO ID; records that cannot be verified produce no download command.
